domain:ui#4 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVfPeFZkN1FP93imKU

Scope note for this card's list (ruling F of #29349, via #29428: every platform language complete on every surface) · 2026-11-05T17:53Z

One server surface that is not a `translations/` package and is not on the per-package list above: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/organization-mfa-enrollment-guard.ts` writes its user-facing copy by hand, `ORGANIZATION_MFA_REFUSAL_COPY` and `ORGANIZATION_MFA_REQUIRED_NOTICE_COPY`, keyed by `type CopyLocale = 'en' | 'zh-CN' | 'ja-JP' | 'es-ES'` (`:149` on `origin/main`); every other caller locale is answered in English (`copyLocaleFor`).

Why it matters now: since PR #30592 (#30565, merged 17:51Z) the console drops its own "7 days" line when the save answer's notice is this server notice, so an administrator in `de`, `fr`, `ko`, `pt-BR`, `ru` or `ar` reads the English notice alone where the console used to add a localized line.

For whichever PR adds the seven table locales to this copy: the console recognises the notice by its opening sentence, `SERVER_MFA_NOTICE_OPENINGS` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizationMfaNotices.ts` (`:70`), with a byte-exact fixture per language in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/organizationMfaNotices-30295.test.tsx`. Each new language's opening sentence goes there in the same PR (the same-PR follow rule). If it does not, the toast shows both lines in that language, never neither. ⛔ Not a claim.
